role: T24B audits the T19/T20 low-level remove/replace surface in crates/mad-dom-bun/src/handle.rs and freezes it here; it adds no new native export, so no symbol is duplicated (per the T20A seam rule). appendChild/insertBefore belong exclusively to T24A (mutation_insert_api)

removeChild.behavior: removes child from parent's child list; child becomes detached (parent/sibling reads return null) but stays live in the arena with its subtree and can be re-inserted; failure leaves the tree unchanged (atomic)

replaceChild.behavior: replaces child with node in parent's child list; child becomes detached; node is moved with its subtree, or a DocumentFragment's children are spliced in (the fragment is emptied); replacing a node with itself is a no-op; failure leaves the tree unchanged (atomic)

identity.rule: the removed/replaced node keeps the wrapper minted by crate::handle::SharedDocument::wrap_node (the per-document weak wrapper cache, T20): while a wrapper is alive, re-reading or re-inserting the same node hands back one and the same JS object (strict equality)
identity.distinct: detach never reuses an arena slot and never rebinds a wrapper to a different node; a removed node's NodeId stays live and valid

delegation.rule: extensions delegate every tree write to Core through crate::handle::with_document (Document::remove_child / Document::replace_child); no second DOM state; a Core NodeId is never fabricated and never crosses the boundary as a primitive; no tree rule is re-implemented in the binding
